description: Dimethylxanthine bronchodilator: π→π* absorption at 272 nm (ε ~10200) from the xanthine purine-2,6-dione chromophore in 0.1M HCl. Structurally similar to caffeine but with one fewer N-methyl group; the secondary N-H at position 7 confers slight acidity (pKa 8.6).
chromophore: Xanthine (2,6-dioxopurine) conjugated ring system with N-H chromophore
transition: π → π* (xanthine purine chromophore at 272 nm)
clinicalNote: Bronchodilator used in asthma/COPD therapy. Narrow therapeutic index; TDM monitoring essential. Pharmacopoeial UV assay at 272 nm in 0.1M HCl (ε 10200). Official BP monograph wavelength.

sources.citation: British Pharmacopoeia 2023, Theophylline Monograph. UV assay at 272 nm in 0.1M HCl; ε = 10200 L·mol⁻¹·cm⁻¹.
